scope: SP01.3 proposed successor semantic and signing contract derived from accepted roadmap and existing design proposal. No semantic freeze before full challenge reconciliation and consequential majority decision.
resultText:
I'll implement the SP01.3 successor semantic and signing contract as reviewable artifacts in this worktree only. First I will load the sprint packet, reconciliation, language-design proposal, and registered financial sources.Writing skill needs subagents, which this sprint forbids, so I will draft the artifacts directly from the sprint packet and source pins. Next I will read the SP01.3 packet, RP01, language design, and registered financial evidence.I have the design sources. Next I will pin file hashes, inspect the old codec and numeric profile, and check whether a JSON Schema validator is already installed.I have the pins and the old-profile boundary. Next I will write the successor contract, schema, and decisions, then generate signed examples and hashes with Python only.I’ll close the `StoredValue` hole, then generate canonical examples and hashes with Python’s standard library.The examples file is over the total size budget because it repeats full documents. I will compact it to mutations plus two valid canonical encodings.Four artifacts are under budget. I will write the Foreman reports and run the final identity, schema, and hash checks.SP01.3 successor contract artifacts are in this worktree as a **proposal**, not a freeze. Independent GPT-6 still has to review them. SP01.2 was not read and is not treated as approved.

**Owned files (119792 bytes, limit 122880)**

- `experiments/moriarty-language/spec/successor/semantic-contract.md` (4424 words)
- `experiments/moriarty-language/spec/successor/signing-display-schema.json` (draft 2020-12, closed objects, ExactPlan / OutcomeIntent)
- `experiments/moriarty-language/spec/successor/semantic-decisions.json` (15 entries, `proposed` or `inherited-constraint`)
- `experiments/moriarty-language/spec/successor/signing-examples.json`
- `FOREMAN_REPORT.md` / `FOREMAN_REPORT.json`

**Contract contents.** Finite domains with proposed UInt/SInt widths. `Amount<Asset>` versus record `Debt<Denomination>`. Staged `pre` / `next` / `post`. Typed Core ops tied to DA01–DA24. Five composition operators. Recovery work. Four mandatory claims. ExactPlan body hash excludes signature, auth digest, and proof. Host SHA-256 uses new `MORIARTY-SUCC-*/0` tags. Atomic `MORIARTY-*-bounded-atomic/1` domains are not reused as accepted successor crypto.

**Checks that ran.** `jsonschema` 4.19.2 Draft 2020-12, read-only. Both valid canonical documents pass. Fifteen invalid mutations match the intended schema-versus-context stage. Digests recomputed with Python `hashlib`, not `codec.ts`.

- ExactPlan digest: `40d8a0c5f2365226cdf010204643b78131757441b3c5ccc411b85f414d0d4261`
- OutcomeIntent digest: `875cefef0592f403dda3168e1364737e56cd3a273bbcca7cf4f55dacccb803eb`

Old `bounds.json`, `types.ts`, and `codec.ts` bytes are unchanged. No runtime, proof, network, install, or commit.

**Still open before any freeze.** SP01.2 reconciliation, user-selected majority on `majorityRequired` choices, native hash correspondence, usability evaluation, formal proofs, and a new SP02 `bounds.json`.
